name: Souya Misato
source:
[url=https://vndb.org/c22211]Yuuji[/url]'s homeroom teacher and [url=https://vndb.org/c989]Misaki[/url]’s older sister.

Although she is a teacher, she tends to hang around with Yuuji and co. on their get-togethers and generally tends to act as “one of the guys”. She likes to get drunk once in a while and generally is a complete ditz.

[Edited from [url=http://animehistory.wordpress.com/2008/03/23/snow-sakura-visual-novel/]Anime History[/url]]
